'''''Eriocephalus racemosus''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the genus ''[[Eriocephalus]]''. It is endemic to the [[Cape Provinces]] of South Africa.<ref name="SANBI" /> It is also called the '''''kapokbos''''' (Afrikaans for snow bush).

== Distribution ==
'''''Eriocephalus racemosus''''' is found in sandy soil along the coast, extending from [[Hondeklip Bay]] to [[Melkbosstrand|Melklbosstrand]], and from [[Port Elizabeth]] to [[Lambert's Bay]].<ref name=":0" />

== Subspecies ==
There are 2 [[Infraspecific name|infraspecific named]] [[Variety (botany)|varieties]] of the species ''racemosus'':<ref>{{Cite web |title=Eriocephalus racemosus L. |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/8094450 |access-date=2022-04-14 |website=www.gbif.org |language=en}}</ref>

* ''Eriocephalus racemosus'' var. ''racemosus''
* ''Eriocephalus racemosus'' var. ''affinis'' (DC.) Harv.

== Conservation status ==
''Eriocephalus racemosus'' is classified as ''Least Concern'' as it is quite common in its natural habitat.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Eriocephalus racemosus {{!}} PlantZAfrica |url=http://pza.sanbi.org/eriocephalus-racemosus |access-date=2022-04-14 |website=pza.sanbi.org}}</ref>

== Uses ==
This species, ''Eriocephalus racemosus,'' along with ''[[Eriocephalus ericoides]]'', have been used at the Cape for their [[Diaphoresis|diaphoretic]] and [[diuretic]] effects.<ref name="WattPP">Watt, John Mitchell; Breyer-Brandwijk, Maria Gerdina: The Medicinal and Poisonous Plants of Southern and Eastern Africa 2nd ed Pub. E & S Livingstone 1962</ref>
